ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) for a period of 90 days, the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (2) for a period of 12 months following delivery, each deliverable and all software will conform to its documentation; (3) it will perform its obligations in compliance with all applicable laws; and (4) the software will not contain any malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is repair, replacement, or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only mutual corporate authority warranties, so we have added a new Section 9(c) performance warranty from HDI: professional and workmanlike Services for 90 days, 12-month conformance of deliverables and software to documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund as our remedy. This is our standard performance-warranty position; if helpful we can discuss the conformance periods.
proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 9(c) HDI performance warranty (90-day professional and workmanlike Services, 12-month software/deliverable conformance to documentation, compliance with laws, no malicious code) with repair, replacement or refund remedies.
